tools.name: create_event_checklist
tools.description: Agentic tool to create a new collaborative event checklist (e.g. for BBQs, camping, picnics, potlucks, dinners) with categorized items, required quantities, date, location, and host name. Returns live shareable URL and WhatsApp copy.

tools.name: get_event_checklist
tools.description: Inspect the current status of an event checklist, including items claimed vs unclaimed, percentage completed, and attendee allocations.

tools.name: claim_checklist_item
tools.description: Claim an item on the event checklist on behalf of a guest/attendee.

tools.name: add_checklist_items
tools.description: Append additional food, drinks, or supply items to an existing event checklist.

tools.name: suggest_event_template
tools.description: Returns curated category and item templates for specific event types (e.g. BBQ, Picnic, Camping, Potluck Dinner).

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "create_event_checklist" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
